Content calendar for The Way Agency blog. Single source of truth for all blog content — planned, in-progress, and published.

Updated 2026-05-02: Re-paced future entries from 1×/week (Wed) to 2×/week (Wed + Sat). Fixed entries (week 1-5) untouched. New schedule runs through ~2026-10-14; plan year-2 content by mid-September.

Updated 2026-08-04: REVERTED the 2026-05-02 re-pace for all unpublished entries. That change re-dated posts by list position rather than by target date, compressing a 52-week editorial arc into ~29 weeks and pulling every future post 91-161 days early — seasonal posts landed months out of season (a winter-driving guide was scheduled for 2026-08-19 and caught in review). Restored each unpublished entry to the date in its markdown `date:` frontmatter, which was authored against the original 1×/week Wednesday schedule. Calendar now runs through 2027-03-24 at 1×/week. Posts already published under the compressed schedule were left live. check-data-integrity.js now fails the build if a post's month falls outside its seasonality_window.

Updated 2026-08-05: retired roadmap.year2-year5. They planned content by theme through 2030, which is the same far-future assumption that let the 2026-05-02 re-pace silently re-time a year of seasonal posts. Standing coverage gaps were preserved as `coverage_targets`; what to publish next now comes from the backlog + slot queue, chosen ~14 days out against current signals.
